attributes.description: Separator of expanded column name parts

Suffix for possible position column in case of list expansion. When Spark expands a nested list, it may also add a position column that contains a sequence of numbers starting with 0. The name of this column is constructed from the original name of the column + position_column_suffix. In case it is null then no position column is added at all

Path to the innermost nested list to expand rows from. E.g. customers/customer/orders/order/products/product/options/option. By default, all lists are expanded. However, this would fail if there were multiple lists at the same nesting level. See section Limitations below. When row_expand_path is used, all lists unused in the path are excluded
